newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lisbon Bourse in talks about Paris trading system. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Lisbon Bourse in talks about Paris trading system. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]

text.p: The French Bourses' Association (SBF) said on Friday it would have talks in the coming weeks with the Lisbon Bolsa de Valores de Lisboa about the possible use of the French NSC-Supercac (corrects from NSC-Supercap throughout) electronic trading system.
The cost of the licence would be a one-off payment of a few tens of millions of francs, an SBF spokesman said. There would also be maintenance costs.

NSC-Supercac has been developed by the SBF and started service in 1995. It is being used by the bourses of Brussels, Toronto and Sao Paulo as well as by the MATIF futures markets and the Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
